text: {"lessons":["Selling a stock just because it is showing a gain can cut short further upside; I should judge it against my overall plan, not its separate-account profit.","I should avoid letting reluctance to admit a loss keep me holding a position; review each stock on its prospects and portfolio role, regardless of my average cost.","I rarely trade, so I should stay patient and avoid reacting to small month-to-month changes; check that my holdings remain diversified and aligned with my goals."]}
